requirements.statement: calendar_store/replay shall implement dual-bank 1024×13-bit slot tables with S0 registered SRAM read and S1 qualification in noc_clk; activation only at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement.
acceptance_criteria: BFM active-bank read matches loaded inactive-bank contents after handoff.
No active-bank write occurs during replay.
Storage is exactly 26,624 payload bits per router.

requirements.statement: BG/escape shall use credited XY-DOR vc_buffers with RC→SA→ST pipeline, 1-in-16 non-borrowable BG window, H/V credits 16/20, and 328-cycle 12-hop delivery bound under eligibility premises.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar path never enqueues payload into vc_buffers.

requirements.statement: multicast_fork shall be atomic on out_port_mask; watchdog_demote shall release once and emit lossless XY escape packets for remaining leaves within 2 cycles of available queue capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one reservation release per violation.
No drop of preserved flit/context under backpressure.

requirements.statement: μArch shall not instantiate combine_unit or DCA. Reduce/allreduce use Tier-A PE handoff; CAL_OP_PE_HANDOFF is forward/tag only with no router arithmetic.
acceptance_criteria: Router context and BFM builds contain no combine_unit.
Calendar replay for reduce/allreduce completes without router combine results.

requirements.statement: Analytic PPA for the μArch shall report relative area 1.028× (or lower) and power 0.96× vs IQ-XY, below Trial 1's 1.065×/0.98×.
acceptance_criteria: Documented area delta vs Trial 1 is negative.

requirements.statement: Single noc_clk domain at 2 GHz; one 512-bit flit per granted direction per cycle; H=7 V=9 ramp=1 modeled as link/PE latency, not a second clock.
acceptance_criteria: BFM/mesh timing uses H=7 V=9 ramp=1.
No CDC synchronizer is required in the μArch.
